packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates automerge during the Monday 00:00-07:59 UTC window. The previous "on monday before 8 day of the month" was a day-of-month constraint, not a time of day, so it opened only on Mondays falling in the first week and a patch released on the 9th waited weeks.
Keep the Kubb packages moving together; 4.37.x had codegen bugs.
Workspace packages are linked, not published; never update them.
